python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
module = importlib.import_module('graphene.relay.connection')
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'graphene/relay/connection.py').resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from graphene import ObjectType, String, NonNull
from graphene.relay import Connection
class Item(ObjectType):
 name=String()
class Strict(Connection):
 class Meta:
  node=Item
  strict_types=True
class Default(Connection):
 class Meta:
  node=Item
strict_edges=Strict._meta.fields["edges"].type
print("strict_edges",str(strict_edges),"strict_node",str(Strict.Edge._meta.fields["node"].type))
assert isinstance(strict_edges.of_type.of_type,NonNull)
assert isinstance(Strict.Edge._meta.fields["node"].type,NonNull)
assert not isinstance(Default._meta.fields["edges"].type.of_type.of_type,NonNull)
assert not isinstance(Default.Edge._meta.fields["node"].type,NonNull)
PYREPLAY
